text: Hi! My wife is on an A/5 visa and we are in the gradual process; the final interview/center of life will be in a month. She is planning to apply for permanent residency afterward. We were planning to leave the country for a wedding shortly after the interview, and my question concerns the timeframe between the last interview and the application/processing of the permanent residency: is this possible to leave the country for a few days or does one have to wait in Israel until the application is handed in or processed? In other words: Does one receive another A/5 visa after the final interview and can one ask (and receive) a multiple-entrance visa for that timeframe?
